prompt:
Customers report that after previewing a cart, changing its quantities or delivery region sometimes leaves the displayed quote unchanged. Split rows for the same SKU can also undercharge shipping, and a region with a configured zero base charge incorrectly gets the fallback charge. Fix preview correctness for repeated calls on one application instance. Merchandise and grams must count every unit of every row. Shipping is zero for an empty cart; otherwise it is the exact configured region base, or the wildcard base when that region has no own configured value, or zero when neither exists, plus the configured amount per started kilogram. Zero is a real configured price. Existing invalid quantity, missing region, and unknown SKU errors must still occur after earlier successful previews. Do not mutate caller data, and mutation of a returned quote must not corrupt later results.

Work only in this isolated project. Inspect the available source and dependency APIs using whichever available tools you judge useful. Make a minimal fix in existing implementation source files. Do not change tests, dependencies, package files, configuration, or documentation, and do not add files. You may run the existing npm test and npm run build commands. Check the result with the existing tests. Do not access files outside this project, use the network, install packages, make commits, or delegate work. Report the fix and any remaining failures.

actions.command: /bin/zsh -c "cat test/task.test.mjs test/public.test.mjs src/catalog/{types,read,service}.ts tsconfig.json; rg -n 'shippingTotal|cartFingerprint|preview|zero|region' test/operations.test.mjs src"
